doc: The phases every large change moves through, in order. A phase fans out into agents; an agent ends done or failed; a phase ends when its exit holds. Read by scripts/phasework.py and checked against worker/src/orchestrate.js.

phases.does: One reader per subsystem compares what the spec says with what the code does and records the gap, with file and line.
phases.exit: every slice has an audit record

phases.does: One agent inventories every subsystem the slices do not cover, so nothing unspecified is missed.
phases.exit: the inventory names every uncovered subsystem or says there is none

phases.does: One author per slice builds code where the spec leads and updates the spec where it lags, writing only that slice's files.
One author per uncovered subsystem writes the spec it lacks. Runs beside implement.
Two readers per slice, neither of whom wrote it. Evidence re-runs the claim through another path; adversarial tries to break it.
phases.exit: both reviewers passed every slice, or findings were raised

phases.does: Only the slices with findings are worked again with the finding attached, then verified again. A third round ends the run.
Every slice lands on one branch as one change with a Handoff block.
The whole repository check runs on the integrated change. Red returns the run to fix; nothing merges on a partial gate.
phases.exit: the full gate passed on the integrated change
